items.description: Close and repaint the affected wall opening
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the disturbed area. Allow €350 gross for a localized patch and repaint, not the entire bathroom.
Section 7.1.7(f) covers the first travel charge on this contractor's invoice. Apply the €81 gross reference for one charge.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers minor consumables used in the pipe repair. Allow €12 gross for one small lot of sealing material.
The failed indoor supply pipe is covered under §2.4.3(a). Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 limit the allowance to a like-for-like replacement, estimated at €30 gross for one metre.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers restoration of pre-loss insulation on the repaired run. Allow €18 gross for one metre, consistent with the rock wool reference.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary installer labour at customary rates. Apply the supplied estimate of €63 gross for one hour.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers necessary investigation, but §7.1.8(b) excludes a separate charge for the contractor's own measuring device. The €20 gross estimate is conditional on proof of a covered equipment deployment rather than an own-device charge.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers the first block of necessary technician labour for access and repair. Apply the supplied €425 gross reference for nine hours.
Section 7.1.7(f) permits only the first travel charge on the same contractor invoice, even when repeat visits were necessary. The conditional one-charge reference is €81 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover one equipment deployment charge for necessary drying. Allow €65 gross for the brief drying of the localized wall area.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes the contractor's blades as business equipment. One blade would cost about €10 gross if it were eligible.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers standard fittings needed to reconnect the repaired pipe section. Allow €44 gross for two fittings at about €22 each.

items.description: Second stainless steel pipe charge, 1 m
items.rationale: This repeats line 4 without documenting a separate length installed, so §§7.1.8(c)–(d) favour disallowance. If a distinct necessary metre is substantiated, allow €30 gross.

The shell appears to repeat the one-metre insulation allowance in line 5; §§7.1.8(c)–(d) require evidence of a distinct necessary installation. If substantiated, allow €18 gross for one metre of standard insulation.

items.description: Second service technician labour charge, 9 hours
items.rationale: Section 7.1.8(c) excludes duplicate labour, and the repeat visits alone do not substantiate a second identical nine-hour block under §7.1.7(g). If distinct necessary hours are documented, the supplied nine-hour reference is €425 gross.
